description.en: Take card, Apple Pay, Google Pay and Revolut Pay payments for Casdoor products and plans through the Revolut Merchant API, on Revolut's hosted checkout page.

guide.json.title: Revolut Payments for Casdoor Products and Plans
guide.json.headline: Accept payments with Revolut
guide.json.summary: Sell Casdoor products and subscription plans with Revolut Business: payers pay by card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or Revolut Pay on Revolut's hosted checkout page, and Casdoor marks the order as paid once Revolut has completed it.

steps.title: Get the secret API key
steps.text: Generate the Merchant API keys in your Revolut Business account, as Revolut's **Generate API keys** guide describes, and copy the **Secret key**; the public key is not needed. To try it out first, do the same in the Revolut Business sandbox and copy the sandbox secret key instead.

steps.title: Install Revolut from the Marketplace
steps.text: On the **Marketplace** page of Casdoor, install Revolut and enter the secret key as the client secret. Casdoor adds a payment provider of type **Plugin** with the same name.

steps.title: Use the sandbox, if you test
steps.text: On the provider's page, set **Host** to `sandbox-merchant.revolut.com` while you use the sandbox key, and clear it when you switch to the live key.

steps.title: Add the provider to a product
steps.text: Edit a product, add the Revolut provider to its **Payment providers**, and buy it once to check that you land on Revolut's checkout page.

tips: Prices go to Revolut in minor units of the product's currency, such as cents, so set the product currency to one your Revolut Business account accepts.
Revolut sends the payer back to Casdoor only after a successful payment, and refuses a return address on localhost or an IP address, so test on a Casdoor with a domain name.

faqs.question: Does Casdoor run code from the Marketplace for this?
faqs.answer: Yes, a small WebAssembly module that runs inside Casdoor in a sandbox. It cannot read files or the database, and can only send requests to `merchant.revolut.com` and `sandbox-merchant.revolut.com`.

faqs.question: Does it support refunds or automatic renewal?
faqs.answer: Not yet. Refund payments in the Revolut Business app; plans paid with Revolut are renewed by buying them again.
